summary: SquirrelMail is a browser-based IMAP client written in PHP, functioning as a webmail interface for accessing mail servers. It allows users to read, send, and organise emails directly through a web browser rather than a dedicated desktop or mobile application.
goodFor: It suits administrators seeking a lightweight, traditional webmail interface running on standard PHP infrastructure.
watchOut: The project lacks recent tagged releases and active commits, meaning you may encounter unpatched vulnerabilities or compatibility issues with modern PHP versions.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it typically requires a compatible web server such as Nginx or Apache, along with a PHP runtime environment and a connection to your existing IMAP mail server.
